kills.property: Invariant: only the contract owner can successfully initialize/reset the owner's balance via XBornID(), so for any caller other than owner the call does not change balances(owner); the mutant removes that restriction allowing some non-owner caller to change balances(owner).
kills.change_summary: Remove the require(owner) check so any caller can initialize owner's balance by calling XBornID, changing balances for caller or others.
